Nvidia is significantly undervalued relative to Morningstar's $250 fair value estimate assuming AI buildout growth continues as modeled.
Lumentum offers an attractive entry point to gain indirect exposure to Marvell Technology at a deeper discount via their pending merger.

Lennar is trading at a discount to fair value and benefits from downside protection given Berkshire Hathaway's substantial equity position.
Netflix has fallen into 4-star undervalued territory after the market over-extrapolated recent growth deceleration.
McCormick presents long-term value and a solid dividend yield as the market adjusts to its prospective deal with Unilever's food division.
